catalog_claims: 'The immutable fifteen-export proof (tree/697a2a1.../linear-systems-and-elimination/IE-16/lean) verifies Holden's exact finite counterexample and the negation of the complete original inequality, including attained full and subset minima and a positive actual subset maximum.'
'Actual Ubuntu Comparator, permitted-axiom and default-kernel verification (actions/runs/34774629327/job/103770408910) passed with all controls'

finding_detail: The catalog's verification credit for IE-16 exceeds what its own cited source supports at the cited commit. RESOLVED.md asserts 'Lean verified -- 2026-09-13' with 'Actual Ubuntu Comparator, permitted-axiom and default-kernel verification passed', but the tree page at the exact commit it links (697a2a1) states: 'Canonical Comparator, separate default-kernel replay and final compiled-source acceptance remain pending' and 'This candidate does not change the canonical problem's verified status or permanent ID.' Nuance, recorded honestly: the two sides cite different run IDs (catalog: 34774629327; tree: 34773404263 at revision 281fc37, not the pinned 697a2a1), so the discrepancy may be staleness or different harnesses ('Actual Ubuntu Comparator' vs 'Canonical Comparator') rather than fabrication; the Actions run was not click-verified here. What is pinned and checkable is that the linked tree page disavows the canonical-verification reading at the linked commit. The route that dies is 'trust RESOLVED.md's Lean-verified credit for IE-16', not the witness (Type-A gate PASS) and not the theorem.

lean_scan.challenge_lean_sorry_note: by design: the fifteen statement contracts retained as the Comparator boundary (per tree README)

open_followup: The GitHub Actions run 34774629327 cited by RESOLVED.md was not independently inspected (no live browser in this audit). A human click-through could determine whether it postdates the tree page text and what harness it actually ran.
paper_quote: The verification program certifies the finite witness; it is not a formal proof-assistant verification of the general amplification theorem.
paper_slip: Displayed identity (13), sum nu_{a,b} p*(z_{a,b}) z_{a,b}^l = 0, omits a conjugation on p*; as printed it is false at l = 3 (nonzero rational residual ~9e-6, verified exactly). The conjugated identity sum nu conj(p*(z)) z^l = 0 holds exactly for l = 1..4, is what the paper's own l = 3 computation verifies, and is what the optimality identity (14) needs. Harmless expositional slip; the computation underneath is correct and the conclusion (optimality of p*, M_4 = m) is unaffected.
scope_boundary_consistent: Both sides agree the stronger amplification result (Theorem 1.2) is informal-only / outside the Lean scope, and both agree the reviews are AI-only with addenda pending. No gap on scope or review status.

verdict_note: GAP, not BREAK: no lemma of the paper's proof route was falsified (Type-A exact-witness gate PASS). Per doctrine, gates refute routes, not theorems: the nine-point witness stands on the verified exact certificate; what fails is the catalog's 'Lean verified' credit as pinned.
